# KAYAK

> KAYAK is a travel search and booking platform that aggregates flights, hotels, car rentals, and vacation packages across hundreds of providers to help travelers find the best deals.

KAYAK serves travelers globally with multilingual regional sites and AI-powered tools like Navigator for trip planning and Trips for itinerary management. The platform combines price comparison, real-time flight tracking, and corporate travel solutions to simplify travel planning.

## Key Topics

- Flight Search
- Hotel Booking
- Car Rental
- Price Comparison
- Travel Deals
- Vacation Packages
- Trip Planning
- Flight Tracker
- Travel Blog
- KAYAK Navigator
- Corporate Travel
- Destination Guides
- Budget Travel
- Booking Platform
- Travel Comparison

## Core Travel Search

- [KAYAK Homepage](https://www.kayak.com): KAYAK homepage: search flights, hotels, rental cars across hundreds of travel sites
- [Flight Search](https://www.kayak.com/flights): KAYAK flight search: compare cheap flights and airfare deals across airlines
- [Hotel Search](https://www.kayak.com/stays): KAYAK hotel search: find accommodation deals and compare verified guest reviews
- [Car Rental Search](https://www.kayak.com/cars): KAYAK car rental: search and compare cheap rental cars across multiple providers
- [Vacation Packages](https://www.kayak.com/packages): KAYAK vacation packages: bundle flights and hotels for best travel deals

## Trip Planning & Tools

- [KAYAK Trips](https://www.kayak.com/trips): KAYAK Trips: personal travel assistant for itinerary management and price tracking
- [KAYAK Navigator](https://www.kayak.com/c/navigator): KAYAK Navigator: AI-powered trip planning tool for destination and itinerary guidance
- [Flight Tracker](https://www.kayak.com/tracker): KAYAK flight tracker: real-time flight status, arrivals, departures and gate info

## Business & Content

- [KAYAK for Business](https://www.kayak.com/business): KAYAK for Business: corporate travel management with booking and policy enforcement
- [Travel Blog & News](https://www.kayak.com/news): KAYAK travel blog: tips, trends and news on flights, deals and travel planning
